parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: TLSCipherPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the TLS policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb delete-tls-cipher-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tls-cipher-policy-id tls-bp1lp2076qx4ebridp000000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
